integrity: All-dimensional mathematics is proved by a cyclic incidence upper bound and a primitive-field sequence construction. The standalone checker is supplementary finite corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Only first-order binary Reed–Muller codes and circular overlapping-symbol reads are treated.
The proof determines the sharp distance profile and one simultaneous optimizer, not a classification of optimal orderings.
Exhaustive finite computations through dimension eight corroborate, but do not prove, the infinite theorem.
No claim of improved physical storage performance or independently established historical priority is made.
title: An all-window optimal cyclic read ordering for first-order binary Reed–Muller codes
